# Contributing to dMod2

## As an RStudio project

Working on the package itself is easier from a checkout.

1.  **File → New Project → Version Control → Git**, repository URL
    `https://github.com/dModverse/dMod2`.

2.  Install the dependencies, including the ones declared under `Remotes:`:

    ```r
    remotes::install_deps(dependencies = TRUE)
    ```

3.  **Build → Install and Restart**.

`cppDE` installs the same way and has to be built first: dMod2 compiles the
generated model sources against the headers of cppDE.

## Tests and documentation

The tests run against the installed package, in parallel with as many workers as
`TESTTHAT_CPUS` sets:

```sh
R CMD INSTALL --no-docs .
TESTTHAT_CPUS=4 NOT_CRAN=true Rscript -e 'testthat::test_dir("tests/testthat", package = "dMod2",
  load_package = "installed")'
```

`man/` and `NAMESPACE` are generated by roxygen2 (`roxygen2::roxygenise()`), `README.md` is
knitted from `README.Rmd`. Edit the sources, not the generated files.

## Issues

Bugs and questions go to the [issue tracker](https://github.com/dModverse/dMod2/issues), with a
small model that reproduces them and the output of `sessionInfo()`.
